purpose: Source manifest for Kenya bee-health multimodal Q/A training data.

recommended_datasets.name: TensorFlow Datasets bee_dataset / BeeAlarmed BeeDataset
recommended_datasets.notes: Useful for single-bee and cooling labels, but not Kenya-specific and not enough for frame-level diagnosis.

recommended_datasets.name: VarroaDataset
use_for: varroa infected vs healthy bee images

recommended_datasets.name: Queenless honeybee acoustic patterns
recommended_datasets.notes: 4 kHz, 30-second samples from five colonies. Not a starvation/dearth dataset.

recommended_datasets.name: BeeTogether / OSBH / NuHive audio datasets
recommended_datasets.notes: Use to broaden audio states, then collect Kenyan ASAL dearth/absconding audio.

recommended_datasets.name: Honey bee colony losses in nine Sub-Saharan African countries
recommended_datasets.notes: Use as context for why drought, absconding, pests, queen problems, and beekeeper-controllable factors matter in Kenya.

recommended_datasets.name: Wikimedia Commons / Bugwood/IPMImages
use_for: license-checkable seed images for rare visible conditions
recommended_datasets.notes: Good for seed examples and demos. Do not rely on it as the production distribution.

known_gaps: Kenyan ASAL starvation/dearth acoustic labels are sparse in public datasets.
Nosema-like fecal streaking images need locally licensed photos and lab-confirmed labels.
Bearding vs true pre-swarming requires inspection metadata, not entrance images alone.
Local treatment labels must be reviewed by Kenyan apiculture extension experts before production use.
